summary: Confirmed both requested estimates against their cited PDF pages 23, 28 and 29. PDF p. 29 prints cosine b = 0.014, p = .008 and L2 distance b = -0.014, p = .007. The passage explicitly compares similarity among AI-assisted outputs with outputs created without AI; it is a separate experiment-level analysis, not a human-capital subgroup contrast. The across_people, diversity, embedding_similarity and ai_vs_bau codes are supported. Higher cosine similarity means more_similar; higher L2 distance means more_diverse. AI was available during the week-long production task, so outcome_with_ai=true, outcome_timing=immediate and within_person=null are appropriate. The similarity analyses do not report analysis-specific person counts, observation counts, arm levels, SDs, numerical SEs, confidence intervals, test statistics, observation unit, regression specification or outcome standardization. The corresponding null fields are appropriate. The participant and work totals on PDF p. 24 cannot establish the sample for these analyses. Printed p-values provide uncertainty, but its analysis unit is unspecified, supporting se_basis=unclear. Read the complete 967-line markdown through the final figure captions, including all included supplementary analyses and tables. No additional eligible outcome or contrast was found in the supplied manuscript under extraction-spec rules 4-6. The S1 similarity outcome is already represented; the human-rated creativity regressions in Tables 2 and 4-8 all adjust for post-treatment rater AI identification and are appropriately excluded. Tables 1 and 3 provide full-sample descriptives, not arm contrasts. Self-reports, interaction-process comparisons and moderation analyses are also appropriately excluded. Online Appendices A-F are referenced but absent from the supplied PDF and markdown. Independent urllib requests using User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 to the named OSF storage API and then the printed OSF project page both failed with WinError 10013; unavailable appendix contents could not be checked.
